name: Docker
description: Docker Engine workbench: containers, images, volumes, networks, logs, files, monitoring and Compose apply.

contributions.label: Docker
contributions.description: Connect to a local or remote Docker daemon.

fields.label: Daemon access
fields.description: How the plugin reaches the Docker daemon.

fields.label: Host
fields.description: Docker daemon address. With a DBX transport-layer tunnel enabled, the tunnel resolves the final endpoint.

fields.label: Allow insecure remote HTTP
fields.description: Plain HTTP to a non-loopback host is rejected by default: the Docker API is unencrypted and grants host-level control. Enable only on a trusted network; prefer HTTPS or an SSH tunnel.

fields.label: Socket path
fields.description: Leave empty to auto-detect per OS (Windows named pipe, macOS/Linux /var/run/docker.sock). In SSH modes this is the path on the remote host; empty defaults to /var/run/docker.sock.

fields.label: CA certificate path
fields.description: Used to verify the daemon certificate; leave empty to use the system root CAs.

fields.label: Client certificate path
fields.description: For mutual TLS, fill in both the client certificate and the client key.

fields.label: SSH password
fields.description: Login password; also used as the passphrase for an encrypted private key.

fields.label: SSH private key path
fields.description: Fill in at least one of password or private key; the key file is read by the local backend process.

fields.label: SSH known_hosts path
fields.description: Used to verify the SSH host key.

fields.label: Skip SSH host key verification
fields.description: Accept any SSH host key. Only enable on trusted networks: without verification a man-in-the-middle can intercept or tamper with the Docker traffic.

fields.label: API version
fields.description: auto negotiates when connecting; a manual value must be 1.24 or newer.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.description: Rejects all Docker write operations, container terminals and file uploads.

fields.label: Production environment
fields.description: Marks the connection as production; opening a container terminal then requires an explicit confirmation.

zh-CN.name: Docker
zh-CN.description: Docker Engine 工作台：容器、镜像、卷、网络、日志、文件、监控与 Compose 应用。

io.dbx.docker.connection.label: Docker
io.dbx.docker.connection.description: 连接本机或远程的 Docker 守护进程。

protocol.label: 守护进程访问方式
protocol.description: 插件访问 Docker 守护进程的方式。

options.unix: 本机 Socket（Unix / Windows 命名管道）

host.label: 主机
host.description: Docker 守护进程地址。若该连接启用了 DBX 传输层隧道，最终端点由隧道解析。

allow_insecure_remote_http.label: 允许不安全的远程 HTTP
allow_insecure_remote_http.description: 默认拒绝从非回环地址访问纯 HTTP 的远程 Docker API——该流量未加密，且等价于交出宿主机的 root 权限。仅在受信网络中开启；更推荐 HTTPS 或 SSH 隧道。

socket_path.label: Socket 路径
socket_path.description: 留空时按操作系统自动检测：Windows 使用命名管道，macOS / Linux 使用 /var/run/docker.sock。SSH 模式下为对端主机上的路径，留空默认 /var/run/docker.sock。

ca_cert_path.label: CA 证书路径
ca_cert_path.description: 用于校验守护进程证书；留空则使用系统根证书。

client_cert_path.label: 客户端证书路径
client_cert_path.description: 双向 TLS 需同时填写客户端证书与私钥。

ssh_password.label: SSH 密码
ssh_password.description: 登录密码；同时用作加密私钥的口令。

ssh_private_key_path.label: SSH 私钥路径
ssh_private_key_path.description: 密码与私钥至少填一项；私钥文件由本地后端进程读取。

ssh_known_hosts_path.label: SSH known_hosts 路径
ssh_known_hosts_path.description: 用于校验 SSH 主机密钥。

ssh_skip_host_key_verify.label: 跳过 SSH 主机密钥校验
ssh_skip_host_key_verify.description: 接受任意 SSH 主机密钥。仅在受信网络中开启：关闭校验后，中间人可窃听或篡改 Docker 流量。

api_version.label: API 版本
api_version.description: 留空或 auto 时自动协商；手动填写需不低于 1.24。

read_only.label: 只读模式
read_only.description: 拒绝所有 Docker 写操作、容器终端与文件上传。

is_production.label: 生产环境
is_production.description: 标记为生产环境后，打开容器终端需额外确认。
